/* v3.3.2: premium touch controls — larger tactile stick, animated rings and clear action hierarchy */ #touch .joy{ width:min(142px,34vw);height:min(142px,34vw);border:2px solid rgba(0,240,255,.72); background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,240,255,.17) 0%,rgba(4,16,36,.78) 66%,rgba(0,240,255,.11) 100%); box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(0,240,255,.07),0 0 24px rgba(0,240,255,.24),inset 0 0 24px rgba(0,240,255,.12); } #touch .joy::before,#touch .joy::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:9%;border:1px solid rgba(0,240,255,.25);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none} #touch .joy::after{inset:23%;border-style:dashed;animation:joyOrbit 18s linear infinite} #touch .knob{width:43%;height:43%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 28%,#e8ffff 0%,#55f7ff 18%,#079abf 62%,#06324f 100%);border:2px solid #b9ffff;box-shadow:0 0 10px #00f0ff,0 0 25px rgba(0,240,255,.75),inset 0 2px 8px rgba(255,255,255,.7);transition:box-shadow .12s} #touch .action-btns{gap:clamp(10px,3vw,18px);align-items:center;bottom:max(20px,calc(var(--safe-b) + 12px))} #touch .act-btn{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;text-shadow:0 0 9px currentColor;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,.035),0 0 20px currentColor,inset 0 0 17px rgba(255,255,255,.08);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em;transition:transform .12s,filter .12s} #touch .act-btn::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:5px;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:50%;opacity:.45;pointer-events:none} #touch .act-btn::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-45%;background:linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 38%,rgba(255,255,255,.42) 50%,transparent 62%);transform:translateX(-70%) rotate(15deg);animation:actionSweep 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;pointer-events:none} #touch .act-btn.fire{width:min(88px,23vw);height:min(88px,23vw);font-size:.72rem;border-color:#8dffff;color:#9fffff;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,rgba(65,255,255,.38),rgba(0,94,150,.38) 60%,rgba(0,15,32,.94));box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(0,240,255,.08),0 0 25px rgba(0,240,255,.45),inset 0 0 18px rgba(0,240,255,.28)} #touch .act-btn.dash{width:min(70px,19vw);height:min(70px,19vw);font-size:.64rem;border-color:#fff1a0;color:#ffe77a;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,rgba(255,235,70,.4),rgba(143,74,0,.32) 58%,rgba(25,14,0,.95));box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(255,230,0,.07),0 0 24px rgba(255,180,0,.42),inset 0 0 18px rgba(255,205,0,.2)} #touch .act-btn.on,#touch .act-btn:active{transform:scale(.91);filter:brightness(1.45);box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.08),0 0 32px currentColor,inset 0 0 25px rgba(255,255,255,.24)} #touch .act-btn.dash::before{border-style:dashed;animation:joyOrbit 7s linear infinite} @keyframes joyOrbit{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}} @keyframes actionSweep{0%,22%{transform:translateX(-70%) rotate(15deg);opacity:0}40%{opacity:.8}65%,100%{transform:translateX(70%) rotate(15deg);opacity:0}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#touch .joy::after,#touch .act-btn::after,#touch .act-btn.dash::before{animation:none}}
